product_launches.description: InfluxData has launched InfluxDB 3 Core, a new open source version of its time series database, rewritten in Rust and featuring major architectural improvements such as infinite cardinality, SQL querying, and decoupled compute and storage. overview_description.description: InfluxData is the creator of InfluxDB, an open-source time series database and platform. The technology is purpose-built to handle the massive volumes of time-stamped data produced by IoT devices, applications, networks, containers, and computers. InfluxData is on a mission to help developers and organizations, such as Cisco, IBM, PayPal, and Tesla, in storing and analyzing real-time data, empowering them to build transformative monitoring, analytics, and IoT applications quickly and to scale.

about_short_description.short_description: InfluxData is the creator of InfluxDB, an open source time series database and platform.

product.name: InfluxDB 3
product.description: A time series database and data platform for ingesting, storing, querying, analyzing, and integrating high-volume real-time data across cloud, on-premises, and edge environments.

product.name: InfluxDB Cloud Serverless
product.description: A fully managed, serverless InfluxDB service for collecting and analyzing time series data without managing database infrastructure.

product.name: InfluxDB Cloud Dedicated
product.description: A managed, dedicated InfluxDB deployment that provides isolated cloud infrastructure for production time series workloads and enterprise administration.

product.name: InfluxDB 3 Enterprise
product.description: A self-managed, high-availability time series database for enterprise workloads requiring security, replication, support, and deployment flexibility.

product.name: InfluxDB Core
product.description: An open source, self-managed InfluxDB 3 data engine for recent-data workloads, real-time processing, and edge or single-node deployments.

product.name: InfluxDB Clustered
product.description: A self-managed InfluxDB 3 deployment option for on-premises, private-cloud, and hybrid environments requiring scalable clustered operation.
